title: Protocol onboarding inventory
summary: Which onboarded Cardano protocol has a complete Tx3 bundle. A complete row has a published interface pulled by version and digest, a decoded unsigned resolution on its network's public TRP, six typed clients, docs with a working example, and versioned MCP tools with a matching Skill, all for the same release. A row stays outstanding, with each missing item named, until every item is present.
